stats.packCurrentHelp: Total current through the series string (I). Equal at every series node S1, S2, … SN.
stats.cellCurrentHelp: Current through a single cell — total pack current divided by parallel count. Used for cell thermal limits and ampacity.
stats.fillRatioHelp:
Actual cell area ÷ pack footprint area
Compared to theoretical max: Square ≈ 78.5%, Hex ≈ 90.7%.
Closer to theoretical = tighter packing = smaller pack.
stats.rotationHintHelp: If rotating the pack 90° would improve packing density, a suggestion is shown here.

cellSpecs.title: 1. Cell Specifications
cellSpecs.dataWarning:
⚠️ Data Warning
Database values are static snapshots and may be outdated.

Always verify Capacity, Price, and especially Amps with official datasheets/vendors.
cellSpecs.pitchTolerance:
Pitch Tolerance
Chinese generic 21700 cells can vary ±0.5mm from nominal diameter.

Tier 1: Samsung, LG, Panasonic, Sony — ±0.2mm tolerance.
Generic China: Wider tolerance — requires larger spacing.

packConfig.title: 3. Pack Configuration
packConfig.thicknessHelp: This thickness is also applied to outer edges, increasing total dimensions.
packConfig.layersHelp: Total series count is divided across this many layers.
packConfig.multiLayerWarning: Multi-layer busbar logic is complex. The visualization will output incorrect strip positions for certain configurations.
packConfig.barleyPaperHelp: Adds insulating paper between layers. Increases total pack height by the paper thickness per layer boundary.
packConfig.rollLengthHelp: Assumes one wide sheet of nickel connects the parallel group, dividing the required linear roll length by P.
packConfig.bidirectionalHelp: Editing S recomputes Target V; editing Target V snaps S = ceil(V / cellNom). Same for P ↔ Target Ah. Cell changes trigger a re-sync of the side not currently in focus.
packConfig.generativeHelp: Enter a target voltage and capacity. The algorithm calculates the minimum series (S) and parallel (P) count from the current cell's nominal voltage and capacity.
packConfig.conservativeFallback: A conservative +1S fallback is added when the cell's minimum voltage would drop below the LVC cutoff under load.

simulation.title: 4. Simulation & Efficiency
simulation.higherRho: Higher ρ → more strip resistance → more heat waste.
simulation.ambientTempHelp:
Ambient Temperature
Used for thermal risk estimation (Joule heat & strip thermal).
simulation.wattsOverpower: Includes 150% Overpower capability. Scaled to Max Voltage (4.2V/cell) for peak burst simulation.
simulation.voltageSagHelp:
Voltage Sag (Ohmic)
Immediate voltage drop due to internal resistance (DCIR) and busbar resistance.
simulation.lvcHelp:
Low Voltage Cutoff
The safe minimum voltage limit. Simulation stops if the cell dips below this.
simulation.runtimeHelp: Estimated time until battery hits LVC or 0% SoC.

Distance (mm) between the pack face and the BMS box. Increase to add clearance for wires or connectors.

about.title: About Battery Tool
about.description: Battery Tool is a free, open-source 3D tool for designing custom lithium battery packs.
about.visualize: Visualize Series/Parallel configurations (18650, 21700, LFP, Na-ion) in real-time.
about.physicsDesc: Simulates Voltage Sag, Joule Heating, and Efficiency losses.
about.dynamicDesc: Estimates runtime based on Constant Power/Current loads and SoC.
about.chemistryDesc: Accurate curves for Li-ion, LiFePO4 (LFP), and LTO.
about.feature3dViz: 3D Visualization: Auto-generates spot-welding strips & hex layouts.
about.featurePhysics: Physics Engine: Simulates Voltage Sag, Joule Heating, and Efficiency losses.
about.featureRuntime: Dynamic Runtime: Estimates runtime based on Constant Power/Current loads and SoC.
about.featureChemistry: Chemistry Aware: Accurate curves for Li-ion, LiFePO4 (LFP), and LTO.

onboarding.cellSpecsDesc: Start by selecting your cell type, dimensions, and capacity. Use the Cell Database to search real models from Samsung, LG, Molicel, and more.
onboarding.chemistryDesc: Choose your battery chemistry. NMC for high energy density, LFP for long cycle life, LTO for fast charging. Voltages auto-adjust.
onboarding.packConfigDesc: Set series (S) and parallel (P) counts to reach your target voltage and capacity. Enable generative mode to auto-calculate from targets.
onboarding.simulationDesc: Run load simulations to see voltage sag, heat generation, and efficiency in real-time. Adjust SoC and load to test edge cases.
onboarding.exportShareDesc: Export your design as 3D models (STL/STEP), technical datasheets, BOM, or SVG projections. Save configurations for later.
